images.prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Asset type: complete travel advertising poster for an educational AI-or-human quiz, portrait 2:3. Create a beautiful plausible Swiss travel poster inspired by early 20th century graphic travel advertising, an angular ochre alpine mountain rising above a deep teal lake, forest in the foreground, warm cream paper, flat lithographic colour fields with fine subtle print texture. Strong editorial typography. Include exactly this large heading at top: "ALPENLUFT". Include exactly this smaller subheading at bottom: "Zeit für einen Perspektivenwechsel." No other text, no real company logos, no watermark, no frame or surrounding room. Full bleed poster artwork. Make the lettering accurate and the visual professionally convincing; no deliberate AI errors. This is an explicitly generated example for an educational media provenance quiz.

images.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: educational media-literacy quiz photo. Create one highly convincing natural landscape photograph of an unnamed Swiss alpine lake, green grassy foreground, steep craggy mountains beyond, a tiny wooden boathouse at the shoreline and a few ordinary clouds. Midday soft sunlight, restrained colours, realistic water reflections, documentary tourist camera photograph, landscape 3:2 aspect ratio. No people, no text, no watermark, no graphic borders. This is an explicitly AI-created example for students to guess the provenance; make it plausible rather than surreal.
